tagline.en: The text-to-video route of VideoCrafter1 — generate a short clip straight from a text prompt.
tagline.zh: VideoCrafter1 的文生视频路径——直接从文字提示词生成一段短视频。

en: VideoCrafter1 T2V is the text-to-video path of the open-source VideoCrafter family. Give it a prompt and it generates a short video clip from scratch.

It runs as an inference-only route wrapping the official VideoCrafter text-to-video pipeline, using the Text2Video-1024 checkpoint. Training and download tooling are intentionally excluded — the route is set up for generation only.
In WorldFoundry you supply a prompt and set frame count, fps, and seed; the shared pipeline loads the checkpoint and writes out the video.
zh: VideoCrafter1 T2V 是开源 VideoCrafter 家族的文生视频路径。给它一段提示词,它就能从零生成一段短视频片段。
它以推理路径运行,封装官方 VideoCrafter 文生视频流程,使用 Text2Video-1024 checkpoint。训练与下载工具被有意省略——该路径仅面向生成。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供提示词并设定帧数、fps 与随机种子;统一 pipeline 会加载 checkpoint 并输出视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to generate a short video from a text description alone with the VideoCrafter1 model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想仅凭一段文字描述、用 VideoCrafter1 生成一段短视频时使用它。

notFor.en: Not for animating an existing image (use the image-to-video route) and not for training. Checkpoint licensing isn't stated, so verify terms before commercial use.
notFor.zh: 不适合让已有图片动起来(请用图生视频路径),也不用于训练。该 checkpoint 未标明许可,商用前请核实条款。

en: Text-to-video: generate a clip from a prompt

Runs through the shared WorldFoundry pipeline

推理路径,提供 fps、帧数与种子控制
